description: Establishes age- and gender-specific blood pressure goals for pediatric patients with primary aldosteronism (PA) using published normative data to assess treatment adequacy and avoid over-treatment. Use when managing hypertension in children with PA to evaluate if BP is adequately controlled; triggers include pediatric PA hypertension, BP not normalized with glucocorticoid therapy, and need for age‑specific BP targets.
